description: The multi-family wind curve defect FEMA disclosed in Hazus 7.1
quote: While addressing the issue described above, the team also discovered that the 2- and 3-story multi-family buildings were using the same damage functions as the 1-story multi-family buildings.

description: The Hazus 6.1 flood damage function library expansion
quote: Almost 300 new structure and 400 new content damage functions were added to the Hazus library from multiple USACE sources, the FEMA Benefit Cost Toolkit, FEMA Coastal Probabilistic Flood Risk Assessment (PFRA) studies and the Coastal Resilience Center.

description: The Hazus 7.0 depth-limited coastal DDF assignment rule
quote: Now, Hazus automatically assigns Coastal V Zone DDFs when water depths are 6 feet or greater, and Coastal A Zone DDFs for water depths between 3 and 6 feet.
fema: V >= 6 ft, A 3-6 ft, riverine < 3 ft

description: Count of business inventory depth-damage functions
quote: The business inventory damage function library assembled includes 116 business inventory damage functions (including default functions) provided by the USACE Galveston District.

description: FEMA spelling out the roof deck attachment shorthand
quote: For roof deck attachment, six penny roof panel nailing at 6-inch spacing on the edges and 12-inch spacing in the field (“6d @ 6”/12” roof deck attachment”) was assigned to all single family homes built after 1965, while single-family homes built in 1965 or earlier were assigned the strongest roof deck attachment, eight penny roof panel nailing at 6-inch spacing on the edges and 6- inch spacing in the field (“8d @ 6”/6” roof deck attachment”), because dimensional lumber is more likely to have been used than plywood in older buildings.
fema: six penny nailing, 6 in edges / 12 in field
